base_note: The release the Hermes installer's default stable channel installs (latest vX.Y.Z release). Install it with: install.sh --commit 8fc0374447313e276f6b9a2764bfc750190c966a
apply_order_note: Each patch is a git diff against base_commit and touches its own files, so any subset applies in this order.

patches.purpose: Adds an opt-in delivery gate (cron.deliver_gate) and a pre_deliver plugin hook so scheduled results and send_message messages can be held whole until a time the profile's plugin names; adds cancel_execution for a queued or held delivery.

Opt-in display.quiet_acknowledgements lets the agent stay silent on a bare 'ok' / 'thanks' / thumbs-up without an unexpected-silence notice; opt-in display.unexpected_silence_notice replaces that notice's wording.
zeus_features: no reply needed to a bare acknowledgement

patches.purpose: cron.reasoning_effort for jobs on cron.model, and a separate background-review effort (inherit_parent_reasoning: false) that keeps the parent's warm prompt.

Photon iMessage: tapbacks that mean something (reactions: meaning), link preview bubbles (link_bubbles), optional status stickers, a per-recipient tapback opt-out, and an in-place refresh of a quiet inbound stream instead of a sidecar restart.
zeus_features: status stickers (inert on this base, see docs)
